_about: Seed for the Notion 'Exercise Library'. src = exact name in yuhonas/free-exercise-db (Unlicense); photos are downloaded from it by tools/build_library.py. match: Exact | Close | None. steps are only written here when the dataset has none for this movement.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.note: Photos show the cat (rounded) half. Alternate: round the back up, then let the belly drop and lift the chest.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
steps: Hold a wall or doorframe for balance.
Swing one leg forward and back like a pendulum, 10-15 times, letting the range grow.
Turn to face the wall and swing the same leg side to side across your body, 10-15 times.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: Easy Walk
exercises.also: Easy walk + leg swings, Warm-up walk
steps: Walk at an easy, relaxed pace for the time given.
Swing the arms and breathe through the nose.
Finish warm, not tired.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.note: Shown with a kettlebell. With a dumbbell, hold one end vertically against your chest; the movement is the same.
exercises.cue: Chest up, elbows inside the knees, sit between the heels.

exercises.name: DB Floor Press
exercises.cue: Elbows about 45 degrees, pause when the upper arm touches the floor.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.cue: Start from a dead hang, pull the chest to the bar, no kicking.

exercises.name: DB RDL
exercises.also: Dumbbell RDL, Romanian Deadlift, DB Romanian Deadlift, RDL
exercises.note: Photos show a stiff-leg version. For an RDL keep a soft bend in the knees and push the hips back; stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch.
exercises.cue: Hips back, flat back, dumbbells close to the legs.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.also: Dip, Bodyweight Dips, Parallel Bar Dips
exercises.cue: Shoulders down and back, lower until the upper arm is about parallel.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.also: Goblet Box Squat, DB Box Squat
exercises.note: Shown with a barbell. At home, hold a dumbbell goblet-style and sit back to a chair or step set at pain-free depth, touch, then stand.
exercises.cue: Sit back to the box, touch lightly, drive up through the heels.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.also: BSS, Rear Foot Elevated Split Squat, DB Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.cue: Most weight on the front foot, torso tall, back knee drops straight down.

exercises.name: DB Overhead Press
exercises.also: Dumbbell Overhead Press, DB Shoulder Press, OHP, Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Ribs down, squeeze the glutes, press straight up.

exercises.name: One-Arm DB Row
exercises.also: One-Arm Dumbbell Row, Single-Arm DB Row, DB Row
exercises.cue: Flat back, pull the elbow toward the hip.

exercises.name: KB Swing
exercises.also: Kettlebell Swing, KB Swings, Kettlebell Swings
exercises.note: Shown one-handed. Default to two hands on the handle; the hip snap is the same.
steps: Stand with feet a bit wider than the hips, bell a foot in front of you.
Hinge at the hips, grab the handle with both hands, and hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height; the arms just guide it.
Let it swing back between the legs and go straight into the next rep.
exercises.cue: Hike it back, snap the hips, arms just guide the bell to chest height.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.note: Photos show a gym knee-raise station. At home, hang from the pull-up bar, then bend the knees and bring them toward the chest.
exercises.cue: No swinging, curl the pelvis up at the top.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.also: Reverse Lunges, DB Reverse Lunge, Rear Lunge
exercises.cue: Step back, both knees about 90 degrees, push through the front heel.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.cue: Body in one straight line, chest to a fist's height from the floor.

exercises.name: Incline Push-ups
exercises.cue: Hands on a sturdy surface, same straight body line as a push-up.

exercises.name: Chin-ups
exercises.cue: Palms facing you, chest to the bar, full hang at the bottom.

exercises.name: DB Thruster
exercises.note: Shown with kettlebells. With dumbbells: hold them at the shoulders, squat, then drive up and press overhead in one motion.
exercises.cue: Use the leg drive to launch the press.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.also: Farmer's Carry, Farmers Walk, Farmer's Walk
exercises.cue: Tall posture, shoulders packed, short quick steps.
exercises.note: Shown with gym farmer's handles. At home, carry a heavy dumbbell in each hand.

exercises.name: Front Plank
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes and quads, ribs down, straight line head to heels.

exercises.name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with the forearm under the shoulder and feet stacked.
Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold for the time given without letting the hips sag, then switch sides.
exercises.cue: Hips high, push the floor away with the forearm.

exercises.name: Pull-up Negative
exercises.also: Pull-up Negatives, Negative Pull-ups, Slow Negatives, Eccentric Pull-up
exercises.note: Uses the pull-up photos. Jump or step up to the top position (chin over the bar), then lower yourself as slowly as you can, 3-5 seconds.
exercises.cue: Fight the way down, control all the way to a dead hang.

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL
exercises.also: Single Leg RDL, One-Leg RDL, SL RDL
exercises.note: Shown with a kettlebell. A dumbbell works the same way.
exercises.cue: Hips square to the floor, back leg and torso move as one.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.cue: Drive through the heels, squeeze the glutes at the top, don't arch the low back.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.also: Single Leg Glute Bridge, One-Leg Glute Bridge

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.cue: Drive through the top foot, don't push off the bottom one.

exercises.name: DB Curl
exercises.also: Dumbbell Curl, Bicep Curl, Biceps Curl

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise
exercises.also: Lateral Raise, Side Lateral Raise, Lateral Raises

exercises.name: DB Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.also: Overhead Triceps Extension, Triceps Extension, DB Triceps Extension

exercises.name: DB Rear Delt Raise
exercises.also: Rear Delt Raise, Reverse Fly, DB Reverse Fly, Bent-Over Reverse Fly
exercises.note: Shown seated on a bench. Standing bent over with a flat back works the same.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.also: Top Hold, Flexed-Arm Hang, Bar Hang, Top Holds
steps: Dead hang: grip the bar shoulder-width and hang with straight arms, shoulders slightly pulled down. Hold for time.
Top hold: step or jump up so your chin is over the bar and hold that position for time.
Both build grip and the strength to finish a pull-up.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
steps: Start on hands and knees, back flat.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body.
Pause for 2 seconds without rocking the hips, return, and switch sides.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
steps: Lie on your back and press the low back into the floor.
Lift the shoulders and straight legs a few inches off the floor, arms by your ears or at your sides.
Hold for time. Bend the knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step, heels hanging off. Hold a wall for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes and pause.
Lower slowly until the heels drop below the step.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.note: Photos show a star jump (a bigger jump). For jumping jacks, hop the feet out and in while the arms go overhead and back down.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.also: Jump Squats, Squat Jump, Squat Jumps

exercises.name: Burpee
steps: From standing, squat and put your hands on the floor.
Jump or step the feet back to a plank.
Jump or step the feet back in, then stand up and jump lightly with the arms overhead.
Low-impact version: step back and in, no push-up, no jump.

exercises.name: High Knees
steps: Run in place, driving each knee up to about hip height.
Stay on the balls of the feet and pump the arms.
Low-impact version: march fast with the same knee height.

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing
steps: Stand in a staggered stance, hands up by the chin.
Throw quick punches (jab, cross, hooks) while staying light on your feet.
Rotate the hips into each punch and bring the hand straight back to guard.

exercises.name: Hill Sprint
exercises.also: Hill Sprints, Hill Run, Hill Runs, Hill sprint 30s / walk 90s
steps: Find a moderate hill.
Sprint up hard for the work time, leaning slightly forward and driving the arms.
Walk back down slowly as recovery.

exercises.name: Brisk Walk
exercises.also: Zone 2 Walk, Brisk flat walk, Brisk walk, nose-breathing pace
steps: Walk at a pace where you can still talk in full sentences and breathe through the nose.
Keep it steady for the whole time. This is Zone 2: easy on purpose.

exercises.name: Easy Jog
steps: Jog at a conversational pace, nose-breathing if you can.
If you can't talk, slow down or walk. Zone 2 is meant to feel easy.

exercises.name: 12-Minute Run/Walk Test
steps: Warm up for 5 minutes.
Cover as much distance as you can in 12 minutes, running and walking as needed.
Record the distance in miles. Gym-ready target: 1.5+ miles.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
exercises.note: Shown with a band. Use a towel or belt around the foot, or hold behind the thigh.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.also: Hip Flexor Stretch, Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch, Couch Stretch

exercises.name: Quad Stretch
exercises.also: Standing Quad Stretch, Side-Lying Quad Stretch
exercises.note: Shown lying on your side. Standing and holding a wall works too: pull the heel to the glute and keep the knees together.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.also: Shoulder Stretch, Cross Body Shoulder Stretch

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercises.note: Photos show folding forward with hands on the head. Start sitting tall, soles together, holding the ankles; let the knees drop. Fold forward only if it feels good.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
exercises.also: Deep Squat, Squat Hold, Deep squat hold 60s
exercises.note: Uses the squat photos. Sink to the bottom position and stay there: heels down, chest up, elbows pushing the knees out. Hold a doorframe if needed.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.also: Doorway chest stretch, Pec Stretch, Chest Stretch
steps: Stand in a doorway with the forearm on the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through gently until you feel a stretch across the chest and front of the shoulder.
Hold for the time given, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Figure-4 Stretch
steps: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest until you feel it in the glute of the crossed leg. Hold, then switch.

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
steps: From hands and knees, bring one knee forward behind the same-side wrist, shin angled across.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Keep the hips square and lower the chest toward the floor. Hold, then switch.
If the knee complains, use the Figure-4 Stretch instead.

exercises.name: Open Book
exercises.also: Open Book Stretch, T-Spine Rotation, Thoracic Rotation
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent to 90 degrees and arms straight out in front, palms together.
Keeping the knees stacked, sweep the top arm up and over to the other side, rotating through the upper back.
Follow the hand with your eyes, pause, and return. Do all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Slide one arm under your body along the floor until that shoulder and the side of your head rest down.
Hold, then open that arm up toward the ceiling. Repeat and switch sides.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobility
exercises.also: Knee to Wall, Ankle Mobility, Ankle Dorsiflexion
steps: Stand facing a wall in a half-kneeling or split stance, front toes a few inches from the wall.
Push the front knee forward to touch the wall without lifting the heel.
Rock in and out for reps. Move the foot back as it gets easier.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
steps: From hands and knees, tuck the toes and lift the hips up and back.
Push the floor away, lengthen the spine, and let the heels sink toward the floor.
Bend the knees as much as you need to keep the back long.

exercises.name: Cobra
steps: Lie face down with the hands under the shoulders.
Press up gently, lifting the chest while the hips stay on the floor.
Keep the shoulders away from the ears. Only go as high as the low back is comfortable.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
steps: Sit with both knees bent to 90 degrees: front leg across your body, back leg out to the side.
Sit tall over the front shin, then rotate both knees over to the other side.
Move slowly between sides, using your hands for support if needed.
